# ColorModel

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public enum ColorModel
```

Which color space a layer's hue and saturation are interpreted in. Only H and S are taken from the color — value/lightness always comes from the grayscale value-map, which is what makes recoloring preserve the art's shading.

## Values

- <span id="f-hsv"></span>`Hsv = 0` - Hue, saturation, value.
- <span id="f-hsl"></span>`Hsl = 1` - Hue, saturation, lightness.
